title: Connected runtimes
subtitle: Connect to an existing OpenClaw or Hermes HTTP API on this device, your network, or your tailnet.
localLibraryHint: Workspace files, skills, and model settings below belong to your local library.
name: Connection name
endpointHint: Use the agent API base address, including its gateway path if needed. A Hermes dashboard address alone doesn't provide chat.
credentialHint: Leave blank to keep the saved credential. Credentials are stored by the desktop app and never shown here.
credentialEmptyHint: Optional. Enter the credential configured for this API.
changedEndpoint: The runtime or address changed. Enter a replacement credential or remove the saved credential before saving.
invalidEndpoint: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS address without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
removeBody: This removes the saved connection and its credential. The runtime will keep running.
noConnectionsHint: Add an API address to test it and start a conversation.
unavailable: Runtime connections are unavailable in this window.
disconnected: The desktop connection was interrupted. Try again.
externallyManaged: You manage this runtime. Start and stop it outside open-quake.
capabilitiesHint: Refresh capabilities to check which operations this endpoint supports.
modelAliasHint: Changing the model route starts a new conversation.
chooseRuntime: Choose a runtime connection to start a conversation.
agentIdHint: This runtime can't list agents. Enter the exact ID, or leave blank to use the endpoint default.
hermesAgent: Hermes uses the endpoint's default agent.
noAgents: This runtime returned an empty agent catalog.
clearHistoryHint: This removes the transcript kept by open-quake. It doesn't delete a remote runtime session.
historyEmpty: No messages in this conversation yet.
historyUnavailable: Conversation history is unavailable in this window.
messagePlaceholder: Write a message to this runtime…
failed: The response failed. You can retry your message.
chatUnverified: Conversation support hasn't been verified. Refresh capabilities before sending.
